annotations.title: Monitor B2B SaaS Sitemaps, Changelogs & Product Launches

description: Inspect target B2B SaaS XML sitemaps and RSS/Atom feeds to detect recent changelog releases, pricing/enterprise page updates, new integrations, and product launches (`corridordata/b2b-sitemap-changelog-launch-monitor`).

daysBack.description: Only include entries modified within the last N days (0 = no cutoff).

maxItems.description: Maximum classified launch/changelog URLs to return.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Optional per-run USD spend cap forwarded to Apify Pay-Per-Event billing (`maxTotalChargeUsd`).

signalCategories.description: Filter specific GTM / competitive-intelligence URL categories.

name: monitor_saas_changelogs
